# Code Review Guidelines

## Testing
- Every new feature should include unit tests
- Prefer meaningful test coverage over quantity
- Edge cases must be included when logic is non-trivial

## Code Quality
- Prefer small, focused functions
- Avoid business logic in controllers
- Follow existing project architecture patterns

## Naming
- Use consistent naming conventions within the codebase
- Prefer clarity over brevity

## PR expectations
- PRs should be small and focused
- Include context in description when adding new features
